Mcp.//ApiKey: API key for the /mcp endpoint. Prefer the MCP_API_KEY env var over storing it here. When empty, remote access to /mcp is disabled (fail-closed).
Mcp.//AllowLocalNetworkBypass: When true, loopback/LAN (RFC1918) requests skip the API-key check so local Claude Code works with zero config. Set false to require the key from every origin — recommended when published externally, since a reverse proxy/tunnel peer is itself an RFC1918 address (see appsettings.Production.json).

OAuth.//Issuer: Public https base URL of this app (e.g. https://maps.example.com). Set it (env var OAuth__Issuer) to enable the OAuth frontdoor so Claude.ai connectors can self-register and sign in. Empty = OAuth disabled and /mcp is reachable via API key / LAN only. Behind a tunnel/proxy, also add the proxy's IP to Auth:TrustedProxies so the forwarded https scheme is honored.

Browser.//ProfilePath: Persistent Chrome profile dir for the shared Google session. Precedence: CHROME_PROFILE_PATH env > this > <AppBase>/data/chrome-profile. Docker sets CHROME_PROFILE_PATH=/data/chrome-profile so the sign-in survives restarts.

RemoteView.//Enabled: Embedded noVNC remote view for the Google sign-in. Enabled in Docker (Browser__RemoteView__Enabled=true) where Xvfb + x11vnc + websockify run; off in local dev (a real window appears instead).

TravelTime.//Provider: Active travel-time provider. 'Mock' (default) = zero-infra smart-haversine straight-line estimates. 'Valhalla' = self-hosted measured road times + geometry over all ground modes (opt-in only; requires the docker-compose 'valhalla' service and the Valhalla section below). Missing/empty/unrecognized = Mock (e.g. the retired 'Osrm' id now falls to Mock).
TravelTime.//Valhalla: Valhalla provider settings (used only when Provider=Valhalla). One self-hosted engine serves all ground modes via dynamic costing (Drive->auto, Walk->pedestrian, Cycle->bicycle), so there is a single BaseUrl (not one per profile). Any/Air is never routed. NFR7: self-hosted, so coordinates never leave the deployment (the region .pbf is fetched only at tile-build time, never per route).

Valhalla.//BaseUrl: Base URL of the self-hosted Valhalla routing engine. Default http://valhalla:8002 (the compose service name + port).
Valhalla.//RequestTimeoutSeconds: Per-request Valhalla /route timeout (seconds); a timeout degrades the leg to Estimated. Default 10.
Valhalla.//GeometryPrecision: Encoded-polyline precision (6 = 'polyline6'). MUST match the leafletInterop.js decoder (factor 1e-6). Default 6.

TravelTime.//AssumedSpeedMetersPerSecond: Any/Air straight-line speed the haversine Mock uses to derive a placeholder duration from distance. Default 13.8889 m/s (50 km/h).
TravelTime.//DriveDetourFactor: [ASSUMPTION] Drive detour/winding factor — multiplies straight-line distance to approximate road distance before deriving duration. Default 1.3.
